item.title: Self-Hosted Records Management: Alfresco Records vs OpenKM vs Mayan EDMS Retention 2026
item.description: Every organization generates documents that must be retained for specific periods — tax records, contracts, employee files, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Records management goes beyond simple document storage: it defines how long documents are kept, who can access them, when they should be archived, and when they must be securely destroyed.
